skill.displayName: Work Productivity Skillscan Security Workflow Helper

llm.summary: This is a workflow/documentation helper with overly broad activation settings, but it does not contain executable code, hidden data access, persistence, or destructive behavior.

dimensions.detail: The instructions explicitly favor local-hardware-friendly scripts, templates, checklists, and small/CPU-safe workflows, which is proportionate for the stated productivity and security-workflow purpose.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The inspected package consists of Markdown/YAML guidance files only; no install scripts, executable scripts, package hooks, or runtime setup commands were present.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The manifest, README files, and trigger sections use broad terms such as security, every, must, before, and bug fix, and agents/openai.yaml allows implicit invocation, so it may activate more often than users expect.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No persistence mechanism, background worker, credential/session access, memory indexing, privilege escalation, or automatic external data transfer was found.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The skill's purpose is to help users create SkillScan-style workflows, checklists, analysis, and implementation support; the artifact content matches that stated purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Before installing, be aware that this skill may be invoked for generic security or workflow language because its trigger terms are broad and implicit invocation is enabled. It is otherwise a low-risk guidance skill; tightening the triggers or requiring explicit invocation would make its behavior more predictable.
llm.findings: [SQP-1] unexpected: The broad trigger and implicit-invocation concern is supported by the artifacts, but it is an activation-quality issue rather than evidence of malicious or high-impact behavior because the skill is documentation-only and has no hidden execution, credential access, or persistence.
